name: Moonlight Ripple cuts the mana cost of Aegis spells by 10% (#1893)
contract: Spell.dbc 503583 Moonlight Ripple (family 32) reads 'Reduces the mana cost of your Aegis spells by $s2%'; effect 1 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), EffectBasePoints -11 with DieSides 1 -> -10, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 0, 0x10000000]. That mask matches only the helper 807032 'Aegis - Mana Cost %' (SpellFamilyFlags word 2 0x10000000, its own effect 0 being a +30 COST modifier on word 1 0x10000000), which no code or SQL ever applies. The Aegis spells 704777, 801126 and 806155 carry SpellFamilyFlags word 1 0x10000000, and their cost is the hard-coded StarcallerCosts row (30% of max mana, ManaCostPercentage with UsesMaxManaForCost, AscensionStarcallerContracts.cpp), so the modifier never touched a cost. Fix: the load-time contract turns 503583 effect 1 into ADD_PCT_MODIFIER -10 on SPELLMOD_COST with the Aegis mask [0, 0x10000000, 0]; SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies it through ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COST) after the percentage cost. Celestial Aegis 801126 is the fixture; the fixture is the same character before and after learning the passive, so max mana and level scaling cancel in the ratio: 30% of max mana becomes 27%, ratio 0.9 (the bounds allow integer truncation). spell_power_cost calls SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost natively and submits no cast. Whether the client data means 10 percentage points (30% to 20%, via helper 807032) rather than a relative 10% is a maintainer question; the tooltip's plain wording is asserted here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Celestial Aegis mana cost without the talent

Learning the passive applies its aura
